stable.notes: Named speakers could be switched off without the panel ever saying so. The voiceprint model that tells speakers apart is fetched by Guided Setup and by nothing else: installing COS Control does not fetch it, and neither does Update Server. Without it every voice is recorded as Me or Ext. Review speakers showed exactly that, two voices in a five-person meeting, with no reason given. The server had been reporting the state the whole time and Control was not reading it. It now does, and shows a banner with a Guided Setup button whenever named speakers are unavailable. A server too old to report it stays quiet.
